label: GO step after a reward collected in S1 (strongest after rare a2->S1 rewarded), early/mid episode only
explanation: Fires only at GO, and only when the previous trial was rewarded (no activity at D1/D2 or after unrewarded trials). Within that, it is concentrated on GOs where the previous reward came from S1 (prev_state==1; prev_state is unknown on the window first trial, so -1 is allowed). It is almost entirely confined to ep_trial < 60 and is silent after trial ~70, so it acts as a slowly decaying within-episode signal. Its magnitude is largest after rare-rewarded trials that reached S1 via a2 (this subset has precision 0.35 and holds 46% of the mass); in those cases the agent usually switches to a1. Steady common-rewarded a1 streaks give moderate, slowly drifting values. It fires mostly when the agent picks a1 (73% of mass). Precision is low (~0.17): only a minority of rewarded-S1 GOs activate, so some unobserved slow variable (episode time / confidence) gates it. Uses only observed variables.
